correctness.rationale: Independently differentiated integral Hankel determinant with SymPy, obtaining five expected quadrics. In char2 Euler gives F in derivative ideal; charts a=1 and e=1 reduce to k[t,u]/(u²). Overlap q=t^-1+ut^-4, v=ut^-6 gives O(-6) nilradical and nonzero ribbon class in H¹(O(-4)). Three quadrics height3 form regular sequence, Hilbert series (1+z)^3/(1-z)^2, independently checking 8m-4 for m=3..11, omega=O(1). Char!=2 local elimination yields reduced Veronese; char3 requires retaining F in Jacobian ideal, as source does.

originality.rationale: Balanced canonical ribbon three quadrics and gluing are explicitly ALREADY in Deopurkar–Fedorchuk–Swinarski Theorem4.4/Cor4.8; ordinary chordal-cubic rational quartic locus is classical. Only new asserted identification is intrinsic char2 Jacobian scheme with that ribbon, plus fiber Hilbert polynomial jump. That is a close elementary combination but not expressly covered in inspected primary portions; exact historical priority remains sensitive.
residual_risks: Closest primary canonical ribbon work has the same three quadrics; an existing explicit chordal-cubic Jacobian interpretation could fully cover novelty.
The characteristic-two non-split gluing comparison is short and strongly relies on known balanced ribbon generators; incremental value is narrow.

value.rationale: A nonreduced canonical ribbon appearing intrinsically as a characteristic-two Jacobian singular scheme of a canonical cubic threefold is a useful geometric degeneration and reveals a flatness obstruction; not claiming ribbon quadrics abstractly new.
